verification.retrieval: GitHub Contents API base64 bytes at the exact codeHashSourceCommit
verification.independentGitBlobSha1: Recomputed Git blob SHA-1 using blob <byte-length> NUL <raw-bytes>; all four matched the API blob SHA
verification.sha256: Computed by Python hashlib.sha256 over exact checked-out raw bytes; the scorer value is independently reported by the GOAL3 CI test log.
verification.lockCommitBinding: Scorer resolves the exact last-touch commit and committer time from Git history; manifest must pin commit SHA, commit time, and lock-file SHA-256.
verification.resultChronology: Every official result fixture retrievedAt must be strictly later than the reviewer lock commit time; equal or earlier timestamps exclude the whole round.
verification.scorerRawByteCheck: GOAL3 CI measured 33824 raw bytes, Git blob SHA-1 472dfd22bc3d16431bdefc697b780be1ad69344a, and SHA-256 d4d0fdfdadcc4c63ae8af70bbd03d67d085dd8352cdab00568a09b1e0fd6f460.

limitations: This lock records code identity only; it does not verify official fixture content or result publication.
The scorer enforces the lock commit SHA/time/file hash from full Git history and rejects any fixture retrievedAt not strictly later than the lock commit time.
Manual fixture, competition, full-time score, and official publication evidence review remains required.
This is not approval to merge, dispatch, or adopt any model change.
